text: Regarding GV-1-5 on the P&ID: How much flow does it pass when fully open? Is there a Kv value?

gold.answer: Yes (solenoid). Versions for 24 V DC, 230 V 50/60 Hz and 115 V 50/60 Hz (ordering tables and coil sets say 110 V); tolerance ±10 %. 24 V DC works if you order the 24 V DC version - the voltage must match the type plate.

text: Regarding FT-15-3 on the P&ID: What flow accuracy can I expect from a 3051CFC compact orifice meter with conditioning option C, range 2, with a beta ratio of 0.50?

gold.answer: HART 4-20 mA: if self-diagnostics detect a sensor or microprocessor failure, the output is driven high or low; the direction is user-selectable with a jumper/switch on the transmitter. Factory default is High alarm unless specified (CT = Rosemount standard low alarm, CN = NAMUR low, C4 = NAMUR high). Levels: default high >= 21.75 mA (>= 22.5 mA with M6, DA1, T9, RK), low <= 3.75 mA; NAMUR >= 22.5 / <= 3.6 mA; custom 20.2-23.0 / 3.6-3.8 mA. Output M: below 0.94 V or above 5.4 V, selectable by internal jumper. F, W, X: failure passed as alert and status.
must: high or low, user-selectable by jumper/switch
